title: Balance Bands for Three-Payment Settlement Offers
content:
# Three-Payment Settlement — Balance Bands

Under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements the balance due that the Placed Consumer Accounts record shows on the offer date places a Three-Payment Settlement offer in a balance band.

Where the account's balance due on the offer date is 2500.00 dollars or more, the Three-Payment large-balance reduction of 2.0 points applies; where it is at least 1000.00 dollars but under 2500.00 dollars, the Three-Payment mid-balance reduction of 1.0 point applies; a balance due under 1000.00 dollars carries no balance reduction for a Three-Payment offer.

| Balance due on the offer date | Band | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 2500.00 dollars and above | large balance | 2.0 percentage points |
| 1000.00 to 2499.99 dollars | mid balance | 1.0 percentage point |
| below 1000.00 dollars | — | none |

## Edge figures (hypothetical)

A balance due of exactly 2500.00 dollars takes 2.0 points and one of 2499.99 dollars takes 1.0 point; exactly 1000.00 dollars takes 1.0 point and 999.99 dollars takes none. One band applies at a time.
